completion_criteria.text: A DETAILED, APPROVED spec exists that makes ALL mitosis git actions performable without fail
The spec eliminates every fabricated-consent / classifier-bypass path (no self-asserted authorization)
The spec makes mitosis NEVER run `gh pr merge` (merge structurally removed, not gated); all PRs stay open; dependents stack on the parent's open-PR HEAD; humans merge outside mitosis
The spec grounds every load-bearing rule in deterministic Claude Code harness/git/server enforcement (never prose), each proven by a red->green demonstration
The spec preserves idempotent resume + reconcile without stable-name ref overwrites (content-addressed create-only refs + compare-and-swap), with concrete re-keying
The spec is grounded by the approved report + deep-audit artifact and survives adversarial review

spine.active_goal: Replace the torn-down client layers with two halves. (1) Server boundary: human-applied GitHub ruleset + separate machine-user identity, guarded by a REQUIRED preflight that PARKS a run unless it verifies. (2) Deterministic restack (0012): BUILD in-engine - persist a checkpoint SHA per unit, drive `git rebase --onto <merge-sha> <checkpoint> <branch>`, read conflicts from git state, never self-report. Items 1-3 DONE; remaining: preflight, restack driver, MSP-4.
spine.next_step: Four items. (1) CONFIRM the runbook's ~10 flagged unknowns against live GitHub docs FIRST - its Section 7 gh api field names are UNVERIFIED and that table IS the preflight's contract. (2) BUILD the preflight: seat before phase('Reconcile') mitosis.js:3591, halt via failedRun mitosis.js:123; verify ruleset ACTIVE, empty bypass, >=1 review, identity NOT admin. (3) FIX squash-blindness at BOTH sites (2964-2974, 4452-4453), replace with the 0012 driver. (4) Commit teardown + runbook.
open_risks: Runbook is AUTHORED, NOT APPLIED, and its citations are UNVERIFIED - the author had no network and cited GitHub docs from training knowledge. Confirm the ~10 flagged items before the preflight hard-codes its gh api field names.

TOP PRE-MORTEM: the HUMAN-APPLIED steps never happen, the boundary never exists, and mitosis ships on a shared identity while everyone believes the server layer is live. The preflight is the mitigation and is NOT optional.

LIVE DEFECT, unfixed: both restack sites use `merge-base --is-ancestor` as their ONLY containment check. A SQUASH merge defeats it, so the engine RE-APPLIES already-landed content. Bites today, independent of the rewrite.

STALE-GREEN: auto-retarget fires pull_request type `edited`, excluded from Actions' default opened/synchronize/reopened. A retargeted PR shows its OLD check result - green against a base it was never tested against.

Auto-retarget does NOT dissolve restack: only a true merge commit keeps the child diff clean; squash and rebase rewrite parent SHAs and force one. Multi-hop cascade is undocumented, with reports of the child AUTO-CLOSING.

PUSH SAFETY: repo is PUBLIC. main is 35 commits ahead and unpushed but CLEAN. Commit d57e233 (on feat/mitosis-resilience) carries the flagged confidential codename - SCRUB before ever pushing that branch.
